text: Health anxiety involves excessive worry about illness and heightened vigilance toward bodily sensations. These concerns may relate to reduced physical activity and musculoskeletal symptoms such as low back pain (LBP). However, the interrelationships among health anxiety, physical inactivity, and LBP in Chinese university students remain insufficiently explored. This study examined these associations using structural equation modeling (SEM).
source_label: The association of health anxiety with low back pain and physical inactivity in Chinese university students: a structural equation modeling study
